title: EV Charging Station Price in Pakistan 2026 — Level 2 AC & DC Fast Charger, OCPP 2.0, NTRC EV Policy Buyer Guide
summary_html: Complete buyer guide to EV charging station prices in Pakistan 2026. Covers Level 2 (7kW–22kW) and DC fast chargers (30kW–150kW), NTRC EV Policy connector mandates (Type 2 / CCS2), LESCO EV-1 tariff rates, OCPP 2.0.1 protocol selection, CPO total setup cost breakdown (~PKR 7.8M for 60kW × 2 station), solar + BESS integration for load-shedding resilience, and PSQCA PS:5201:2023 safety compliance. Includes 14 tables and 5 FAQs.
